deadline.value: Apply by January 15, 2027 for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Near Eastern & Judaic Studies, Social Policy (Heller), History | January 15

gre_subject.value: No Mathematics subject test requirement is stated on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: No supervisor agreement is needed to apply; a dissertation advisor is chosen later.
supervisor.quote: By the end of their second year, students should select a dissertation advisor

funding.value: Students in good academic standing have scholarship, health insurance and stipend guaranteed through year five.
funding.quote: Scholarships, health insurance and stipends are guaranteed through year five for students in good academic standing.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's degree to apply.
entry_route.quote: You must hold (or be about to earn) a bachelor’s degree from an accredited U.S. or international institution.

notes: Funding and advisor rules from the 2025-2026 PhD handbook. The GRE is optional for Mathematics under the graduate school rule.
